title: Separate API and Worker container images
statement: The same Vistara release produces separately deployable API and Worker container images with role-specific runtime contents.
rationale: Independent process roles preserve the modular-monolith release model while allowing production API and background workloads to scale and operate separately.

evidence.locator: | Production example | Migration task, API, worker, PostgreSQL, MinIO/reverse proxy; external object storage supported |
- Docker images and starter/production Compose environments.
